This issue can only be reproduced in Safari on both Mac and iOS.

It can be fixed by unblocking this specific rule: `decrypt.day#@#div[class] > center:has(> div.w-full > ins.adsbygoogle)`. We already have an indirection rule for this selector: https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/f2af72db2defdd7de0096c71345c85244c808c32/BaseFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt#L3967

However, even after applying the rule above, the issue persists on iOS. The issue goes away after turning off AdGuard DNS. It seems to be the same issue as the one discussed here: https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/228989#issuecomment-4441328168
